description: Installation of seven internally illuminated fascia and Totem sign to the existing Car Showroom
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The display of the advertisement hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission

Condition : 3 - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to-
(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 6 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity

Condition : 7 - The sign hereby approved shall be static display and not have any moving features, animation, intermittent light source or exposed cold cathode tubing. The sign must not flash or change colour and the lighting is to be as described in the specification.

Condition : 8 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ((all ref- NIS270121-JH01), Pg1-Indicative site photo 1, pg2-Site Plan, pg3- Site Plan, pg4- Elevation 1, pg5- Elevation 1, pg6- Elevation 2-Visual 1, pg7- Elevation 2-Visual 2,pg8- Elevation 2- Visual 2, pg9- Elevation 2, pg10 Elevation 3, pg11- Elevation 4, pg12- Elevation 5, pg13 Elevation 6, pg14 Elevation 6, pg15 Sign Specification, pg16 Sign Specification; all received 12 August 2021)  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 9 - The illumination of the hereby approved sign shall not exceed 350 cd/m2.

Condition : 10 - The footway and carriageway on Staines Road must not be blocked during the construction and maintenance of the proposal. Temporary obstruction during the installation must be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrian, or obstruct the flow of traffic.
Condition : 11 - No servicing vehicles associated with the proposed signs shall park/ load/ unload on the footway/ carriageway of Staines Road at any time.
